title: Canyons 50K — Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2027
publisher: UTMB World Series / Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB
claims: The 50K is 50 KM with 1,700 m of gain, starts in Downtown Auburn on Saturday 24 April 2027 at 07:00 and has a 10-hour limit; it carries 2 Running Stones.
The route goes from Robie Point over No Hands Bridge and the Clementine trail to the Foresthill Divide Loop, Drivers Flat, Mammoth Bar and the Confluence Trail back to Auburn.

claimVerification.note: 页头：50 KM、1700 M+、Saturday 24th April 2027、Downtown Auburn 07:00、10 Hours、Running Stones 2
